title: Silent Contract
core_verb: Sneak through a guarded estate to eliminate one target and escape.
fantasy: A covert assassin infiltrates a secured estate to complete a contract and leave undetected.
fail_state: You are eliminated when player health reaches zero, or the 120-second mission timer reaches zero before you enter the exit after eliminating the target.
win_state: Reduce the contract target's health to zero, then enter the gold exit marker before the mission timer expires.

interaction_tags.meaning: Patrolling hostile who detects nearby intruders, pursues them, and deals damage until player health reaches zero.
The designated hostile whose health must be reduced to zero before the exit can complete the mission.
Pickup that suppresses guard detection while the player remains outside the target's restricted room.
Goal zone that grants victory when entered after the contract target's health reaches zero.

notes: The stealth sandbox is reduced to one compact single-player contract: infiltrate a small guarded estate, optionally collect one disguise, eliminate one scripted target, and reach one exit.

scene.description: A secured estate at night, high walls around a compound of interconnected rooms and corridors, security lights casting harsh cones on the ground. Guard patrol zones, cover walls, disguise pickups, a target location and a gold exit marker beyond the target building are what the layout has to contain. Hedges, wooden crates, sandbags, a guard booth, security cameras and an iron gate fill the compound: dense, so there is always cover within reach and always a sight line to break.
